grover.label: Grover (Chrome)
grover.about: Grover 1.2.10, Puppeteer, Chrome; charts drawn client-side by ECharts/Vega in Chrome. Warm: Ruby process and Chrome reused (browser_ws_endpoint); the Node process that only keeps Chrome open is left out of the memory sum (reported separately).

excluded.what: the Node process that only keeps Chrome open (bench/grover/browser.cjs); its Chrome is counted

surimono-ruby.label: surimono + fulgur (Ruby)
surimono-ruby.about: Surimono::Renderer#render (islands in QuickJS), then the fulgur gem prints the HTML.
surimono-ruby.reason: surimono 0.0.0 can't render this report yet: renderers echarts, vega, vega-lite not available (it has: surimono-stub)

surimono-rust.label: surimono + fulgur (Rust)
surimono-rust.about: surimono::Renderer::render_islands, then the fulgur crate 0.40.0, in one Rust process (bench/rust, release build).
surimono-rust.reason: surimono 0.0.0 can't render this report yet: renderers echarts, vega, vega-lite not available (it has: surimono-stub)

fulgur-prerendered.label: fulgur only, Chrome's SVGs (reference point)
fulgur-prerendered.about: The fulgur gem prints the report with Chrome's island SVGs already inlined. No JavaScript runs. Chrome's SVGs keep <text>, which fulgur shapes itself, while surimono outlines text by default, so the PDF step is not identical: a reference point, expected to bound surimono's ratios, NOT a surimono result.

grover-shell.label: Grover (chrome-headless-shell)
grover-shell.about: As Grover (Chrome), on chrome-headless-shell of the same build (Puppeteer's headless: "shell"), the leanest Chrome a Grover user can run.

excluded.what: the Node process that only keeps Chrome open (bench/grover/browser.cjs); its Chrome is counted

grover-launch.label: Grover, new Chrome per document
grover-launch.about: Warm only: Ruby process reused, Grover's default of launching Chrome for every document.
